envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: design churn under running plans broke this session's acceptance; the invariant is now in the design
envelope.cause: regrounding with the operator, 2026-09-29: shards state what and why, never how; the design is the fixed goal

payload.gloss: the design is the fixed target while a plan realizes it. A change never moves a shard that a running plan is building against: it is appended to the design and realized by a following plan, sequenced after the work it depends on, so every plan finishes against the goal it began with. Only when a running plan is found to be built on a shard that is itself wrong does the plan stop; the design is corrected once, and the planner rectifies or rebuilds the plan before work resumes.
